description: Just 2 curious minds interested in the history of space exploration
summary: We have created a comic style flipbook illustrating the journey of opportunity rover on Mars. This project aims to introduce Martian missions to school age space enthusiasts through a medium designed for them.
details: We have created a comic style flipbook illustrating the journey of opportunity rover on Mars. This project aims to introduce Martian missions to school age space enthusiasts through a medium designed for them. We utilized canva to create a pdf of the comic book and then used Heyzine editor website to convert it into a flipbook. We chose comic style so that it becomes more appealing to children as well as adults.
